name: port
description: Read your own Port_ port from Codex: net worth, holdings, DeFi, PnL, with the caveats the app shows.

interface.shortDescription: Read your own Port_ port, read only
interface.longDescription: Net worth, holdings, DeFi, perps, predictions, NFTs, PnL, activity, the daily briefing and alerts from your own Port_ account, with what is not counted and how old it is. Needs a Pro account and PORT_API_KEY in the environment.
defaultPrompt: What is my Port_ worth right now, and what is not counted?
What moved in my wallets this week?
What is my realised PnL this year?
